finding.controlFlow: deadline is computed once; while checks Date.now before ownership guard and asynchronous evaluate; a fulfilled value immediately enters isReady and can be returned. There is no Date.now check between settlement and readiness admission.
finding.counterexample: Start at0 with30,000ms budget. First read returnsfalse at0; original100ms wait enters another iteration at100. Second read resolves to an accepted value at30,000 or30,001. The source returns it even though the same deadline has expired. This example does not require a single CDP request to exceed30s: the second request lasts29,900/29,901ms.
finding.equality: Existing loop contract is strict Date.now() < deadline; equality is already expired. Acceptance at equality is therefore an inconsistency, not a permitted inclusive boundary.
finding.independence: P11 private poll already has two post-await checks. Its local reads and tests do not change or exercise this generic function. A later generic readiness gate used even by P11 UI steps remains distinct.
finding.inferenceBoundary: This is a deterministic source-level path deduction. No current/old CI log, reproduction, runtime RED, test PASS, or new execution is claimed.
finding.pendingScope: The defect here is admission of fulfilled late results. Active cancellation/preemption of a still-pending CDP operation, a new total multi-step click deadline, clock replacement, and additional post-guard dispatch checks are outside this bounded requirement.
